name: cachecue
description: Feeds the CacheCue menu bar app: from Claude desktop app sessions, cache hit rate and expiry, limits, context size and session cost; from every session, whether a turn is running or Claude Code is waiting for you, and how much each compaction took off the context. Compacts a session before its cache goes cold only where you turned that on in the menu bar app. Draws nothing in Claude Code itself.
